C:P2.1.text: Who We Are - HireQuest Inc. | Staffing & Recruiting Services Franchise

C:P2.2.text: Learn who we are at HireQuest—our mission, values, and leadership behind our nationwide staffing and workforce solutions.

C:P2.3.text: HireQuest is a franchisor of staffing solutions with a presence across the U.S. and international markets. Through its primary divisions – HireQuest Direct, HireQuest Health, MRINetwork, Snelling, and TradeCorp – the company provides temporary, direct-hire, and contract staffing solutions across industries, including construction, light industrial, healthcare, finance, manufacturing, cybersecurity, and engineering. From on-demand staffing to executive search, HireQuest’s divisions operate as one team for our customers -delivering workforce solutions that drive growth and change lives.
